keyTerms.definition: 12 questions covering P04, P11, P12, P13, P14, P15.
Linked modules to work if you miss more than 4.

recall.question: What happens if you miss more than 4?
recall.answer: Work the linked bridge modules before U01.

keyTerms.definition: Aligns trailing axes and stretches size-1 axes.
Stores past keys and values per layer; avoids recomputation.

recall.question: D01 (P12). A tensor has shape (2, 4, 8). How many numbers does it hold? Write the shape of its transpose over the last two axes.
recall.answer: 64 numbers. Transpose over last two axes: (2, 8, 4).

recall.question: D05 (P13). Define perplexity in one sentence. A uniform model over 1000 tokens has what perplexity?
recall.answer: Perplexity is exp(mean negative log-likelihood). The uniform model has perplexity 1000.

recall.question: D09 (P15). Define arithmetic intensity with units. A kernel does 1e9 FLOPs and moves 1e9 bytes. What is its intensity, and which roofline side is it on at ridge 150?
recall.answer: I = FLOPs/bytes = 1 FLOP/byte. Below ridge 150: memory-bound.

keyTerms.definition: 10-12 proceed; 8-9 light review; below 8 full modules.
Work the linked modules fully, then retake.

recall.question: What are the scoring bands?
recall.answer: 10-12: proceed to U01. 8-9: review the missed bridges lightly. Below 8: work the linked modules fully (see prerequisites), then retake.
